philosophy: Cinema is slow and deliberate. Motion serves narrative, never decoration. Every animation has a cinematic precedent: title cards, letterbox reveals, iris wipes, slow tracking shots.

titleCard.description: Full-black screen; text fades in after delay — classic cinema title sequence
titleCard.notes: Use autoAlpha (opacity + visibility) not opacity alone. 400ms delay simulates the held-black moment before text appears.

letterboxReveal.description: Section content reveals via clip-path height expanding top-to-bottom
letterboxReveal.gsap: gsap.from(el, { clipPath: 'inset(0 0 100% 0)', duration: 1.0, ease: 'power2.inOut', scrollTrigger: { once: true } })
letterboxReveal.notes: Mimics a widescreen letterbox opening. once:true — plays once on scroll entry.

irisWipe.description: Circular clip-path expanding from center — classic iris transition
irisWipe.css: @keyframes iris-in { from { clip-path: circle(0% at 50% 50%); } to { clip-path: circle(75% at 50% 50%); } }

cinematicDrift.description: Slow horizontal drift from right — tracking shot feel
cinematicDrift.gsap: gsap.from(el, { x: 20, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power1.out', scrollTrigger: { once: true } })
cinematicDrift.notes: Subtle 20px x-translate. Never use large values — cinema is restrained.

filmGrain.description: CSS pseudo-element noise overlay animated at irregular frame rate
filmGrain.css: @keyframes film-grain { 0%, 100% { background-position: 0 0; } 10% { background-position: -5% -10%; } 20% { background-position: -15% 5%; } 30% { background-position: 7% -25%; } 40% { background-position: 20% 25%; } 50% { background-position: -25% 10%; } 60% { background-position: 15% 5%; } 70% { background-position: 0% 15%; } 80% { background-position: 25% 35%; } 90% { background-position: -10% 10%; } }
filmGrain.implementation: ::after pseudo on .grain-overlay { content:''; position:fixed; inset:0; opacity:0.04; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,..."); animation: film-grain 0.4s steps(1) infinite; pointer-events:none; z-index:9999; }

staggeredCredits.description: Credit lines rolling in from below, staggered 0.1s each
staggeredCredits.gsap: gsap.from(els, { y: 30, autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.8, stagger: 0.1, ease: 'power2.out', scrollTrigger: { once: true } })

keyframes.name: film-grain
keyframes.description: Noise texture position randomization for film grain overlay

keyframes.name: title-card-fade
keyframes.description: Title card text fade-in after black hold
